newsitem.title: USA: Centura, Triangle buy 23 United Carolina branches.
newsitem.headline: Centura, Triangle buy 23 United Carolina branches.

text.p: United Carolina Bancshares Corp. has agreed to sell 13 banking offices in North Carolina to Centura Banks Inc. and 10 offices to Triangle Bank, the purchasing companies said Wednesday.
Financial terms of both deals were not disclosed.
The sales follow an agreement by United Carolina to merge with BB&T Corp., which changed its name from Southern National Corp. last week.
Centura, based in Rocky Mount, N.C., said the 13 branches have deposits of $311 million and loans of about $200 million. The acquisition will push its assets above $6.7 billion.
Triangle said it will assume about $215 million in core deposits and purchase about $71 million in loans in the deal.

Triangle said the 10 United Carolina offices are located in the eastern and south central North Carolina communities of Fairmont, Fremont, Goldsboro, Hamlet, Lumberton, Plymouth, Roper, Sanford and Wallace.
Triangle, based in Raleigh, N.C., operates 46 offices in central and eastern North Carolina.
Both transactions are expected to close in mid-August, the companies said.
